title: Apply the Chain Rule
text: Treat $$x_i$$ and $$y_i$$ as constants. Differentiate the squared term $$\left(y_i-\theta_1 x_i\right)^2$$.

title: Differentiate the Inner Expression
text: The derivative of $$y_i-\theta_1 x_i$$ with respect to $$\theta_1$$ is $$-x_i$$, creating a second factor of $$x_i$$.

title: Combine the Factors
text: Each summand contributes $$-2{x_i}^2 \left(y_i-\theta_1 x_i\right)$$ then multiply the sum by $$\frac{1}{n}$$.
